_comment: COPY-PASTE TEMPLATES for addons.json. This file is never read by the build -- it exists so you do not have to retype JSON out of the guide. See Book One, Part 3.
_step_1_find_the_id: The add-on ID is not its display name. Read the id= attribute in the add-on's own addon.xml, or use the folder name under ~/.kodi/addons/.
_step_2_choose_a_section: Run the probe command in guide step 3.2. IN official -> use official_template. NOT in official -> use mirror_template. Installs only from a vendor's own repo -> use external_template.
_step_3_paste: Copy ONE template below (without its _hint line), paste it into the matching section of addons.json, and fill in the CAPITALISED values.

mirror_template._hint: Not in Kodi's official repo. Packaged into your repo from GitHub, re-synced daily.
mirror_template.name: Display Name
mirror_template.why: One sentence: what it does and why it earned a slot.

mirror_from_kodi_repo_template._hint: Not on GitHub -- served by another Kodi repository. Point repo_url at the directory holding that repo's addons.xml; the newest version is picked up automatically.
mirror_from_kodi_repo_template.name: Display Name
mirror_from_kodi_repo_template.why: One sentence: what it does and why it earned a slot.

mirror_from_zip_template._hint: A fixed zip URL. Pinned: it only changes when that URL serves different contents, so prefer github or repo_url when either exists.
mirror_from_zip_template.name: Display Name
mirror_from_zip_template.why: One sentence: what it does and why it earned a slot.

official_template._hint: Already in Kodi's official repo. Installed by id, stays on the maintainer's update channel. No github, no track.
official_template.name: Display Name
official_template.why: One sentence: what it does and why it earned a slot.

external_template._hint: Dependencies nobody publishes, or the vendor runs their own repo. Documented only, never auto-installed. Note the different shape: no id, no github.
external_template.name: Vendor Add-on Name
external_template.why: Why it cannot be mirrored -- usually a dependency no official repo ships.

_field_reference.id: mirror + official. Must match the add-on's own addon.xml exactly.
_field_reference.name: all. Display name in the Toolbox picker.
_field_reference.category: mirror + official. Groups and sorts the picker. In use: subtitles, playback, tracking, tools, interface, privacy.
_field_reference.why: all. Your justification. Ends up in the README.
_field_reference.track: mirror only. 'release' (newest release, falling back to branch head) or 'branch' (always the head).
_field_reference.ref: mirror only, optional. Pin a branch, e.g. matrix.
_field_reference.optional: mirror + official. true leaves it UNTICKED in the picker. Use for anything needing credentials, a subscription or extra hardware.
_field_reference.url: external only. The vendor's repository URL.
_field_reference.addons: external only. The add-on ids that repo provides.
_field_reference.repo_url: mirror only. Directory holding another Kodi repo's addons.xml. Alternative to github.
_field_reference.zip_url: mirror only. A fixed zip URL. Alternative to github.

_step_4_dont_forget: Bump the version in src/script.watchame.toolbox/addon.xml, or no device will ever see your change. The build will stop you if you forget.
